body.name: Replicated-donor cross-fitted local-polynomial estimator
body.construction: Set \(K_N=\min\{2,N\}\), assign donors to the deterministic balanced folds \(I_\ell\), compute \(\overline Z_\ell\), and replace every raw fold mean by \(\widetilde z_\ell=\Pi_{([0,1]^d)^S}(\overline Z_\ell)\). The coordinatewise projection is Borel measurable and Euclidean nonexpansive relative to the interior center \(z_0\); covariance ellipticity therefore gives \(\|\Sigma^{-1/2}(\widetilde z_\ell-z_0)\|_2\le(C_\Sigma/c_\Sigma)^{1/2}\|\Sigma^{-1/2}(\overline Z_\ell-z_0)\|_2\). Form \(\overline Q_{st}=n_s^{-1}\sum_iQ_{sti}\). For each \((s,\ell)\), search \(\mathcal B_s\) in deterministic increasing order and take the first \(b\) with \(\lambda_{\min}\{G_{sT}(\widetilde z_{\ell s},b)\}\ge c_G\); all eigenvalue ties are accepted at equality. At that bandwidth use the unique order-\(r\) tensor local-polynomial intercept and clip its fitted value to \([-B,B]\). If the coercive set is empty, record \(\mathsf F_{\mathrm{fb}}\) and define that fold--cohort value as \(\operatorname{clip}_{[-B,B]}\{(Tn_s)^{-1}\sum_{t,i}Q_{sti}\}\), with recorded bandwidth \(1\). Average the clipped values over \(\ell=1,\ldots,K_N\) to define \(\widehat m_s\), and set \(\widehat\tau=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s\{n_s^{-1}\sum_iB_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}-\widehat m_s\}\). Thus \(\widehat\tau\in[-2B,2B]\) is measurable and defined for every \(N,T,n_s\ge1\), including every empty coercive search.
